versions.changelog:
Initial release of github-memory-sync.

- Sync OpenClaw memory files (MEMORY.md and memory/*.md) to a GitHub repository for backup and version control.
- Supports push, pull, status check, and file listing operations via GitHub.
- Easy configuration via environment variables or config file, requiring only a GitHub personal access token and repo info.
- Provides usage examples, safety reminders, and detailed setup instructions.
- Activates when users mention related keywords (e.g., "GitHub memory", "同步 memory").
- Emphasizes security best practices for handling tokens and sensitive data.
